content.value_statement: LLM-facing documentation often wastes context with long explanations and repeated details. This skill turns project knowledge into dense, structured docs for assistants.
actual_capabilities: Rewrites documentation with tables, bullets, and compact examples.
Removes filler words, redundant introductions, and unclear hedging.
Provides a CLAUDE.md and agent documentation structure template.
Recommends progressive disclosure for long documents over 200 lines.
Includes before and after examples for overview, API, setup, and architecture docs.
Provides a self-check list for token-efficient documentation quality.
limitations: It does not verify whether project commands or APIs are correct.
It does not run code, tests, package managers, or external tools.
It focuses on LLM-consumed docs, not full human onboarding guides.
It requires accurate project facts from the user or repository context.

use_cases.title: Prepare Agent Instructions
use_cases.description: Create a concise CLAUDE.md that gives assistants the stack, commands, architecture, and conventions.

use_cases.title: Compress Existing Documentation
use_cases.description: Rewrite verbose README sections into tables, bullets, and examples that preserve key project facts.

use_cases.title: Standardize Technical References
use_cases.description: Apply consistent patterns for setup, API notes, architecture summaries, and long-document splitting.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Agent Doc
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new project guide.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a CLAUDE.md for this project. Include stack, commands, architecture, conventions, and links to deeper docs.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite a Verbose Section
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve one README or guide section.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this section for LLM context. Use tables, bullets, direct wording, and remove filler while preserving facts.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Documentation Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Split a large guide into focused files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an LLM-friendly documentation structure for this repository. Keep the main doc short and link detailed references.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Documentation for Agents
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of existing AI assistant docs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these agent-facing docs for token waste, missing commands, unclear conventions, and sections that should be split.

output_examples.input: A long project overview with repeated descriptions of features, stack, and goals.
output_examples.output: A compact project summary with a stack table, a short feature list, and removed redundant introductions.

output_examples.input: A setup guide written as several paragraphs with requirements and development steps mixed together.
output_examples.output: A short setup section with requirements first, followed by ordered actions and clear command labels.

output_examples.input: A large agent guide that includes architecture, API details, conventions, and troubleshooting in one file.
output_examples.output: A main quick-reference document with links to focused architecture, API, and troubleshooting files.

best_practices: Provide the current stack, commands, architecture, and conventions before asking for documentation.
Ask for tables when comparing modes, services, commands, or configuration values.
Review generated docs against the repository before using them as agent instructions.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for longer documentation when the goal is LLM context efficiency.
Do not publish generated commands or API details without checking them.
Do not mix tutorial prose with quick-reference instructions in the same section.

faq.question: What type of documentation does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates concise documentation for LLMs, including CLAUDE.md files, README sections, technical references, and agent instructions.

faq.question: Can it update an existing README?
faq.answer: Yes. It can rewrite verbose README content into shorter sections with tables, bullets, and direct examples.

faq.question: Does it run project commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides writing guidance only and does not execute commands or validate command output.

faq.question: How should I provide project context?
faq.answer: Provide stack details, common commands, architecture notes, conventions, and any existing documentation that needs rewriting.

faq.question: Is this only for Claude?
faq.answer: No. The patterns also help Codex, Claude Code, and other coding assistants consume project context efficiently.

faq.question: When should long documentation be split?
faq.answer: The skill recommends splitting long docs over 200 lines and linking detailed files from a short main reference.
